contexts.text: The veil is for those who... see the Truth, (but) from the love of self are continually indignant that it is so.
This even to indignation.
Evident from the indignation in (these words).
The affection which is in these words is the indignation as it were of knowledge...
Spirits are very indignant that men... AC 1881.
These are the words of their indignation.
The Lord's indignation. Signified. AC 2720:4.

In temptations... there are despairs, and thence grievings and indignation... Diabolical Spirits... induce what is false from themselves, and at the same time accuse. Hence the Lord's indignation was so great...
The indignation of this first-conceived Rational. Signified.

Here is described the indignation of this Rational against intellectual truth... When the Rational is insurgent against the Intellectual... there is indignation on the part of the one which is subjugated; as is the case in temptations.
I have often perceived the resistance (of the infants) attended with a certain species of indignation.
Evident also from the indignation of those (infants who are of a spiritual genius). HH 339.
A recent Spirit was indignant that he did not remember more things... HH 465.
Indignation. Signified.

(With regard to) the affection of indignation, here treated of, the man who does not know what the affection of charity is... can have no other idea than of such indignation as a man has when evil is done to him, which is the indignation of anger. But there is not such indignation with the Angels; but an indignation quite different, which is not of anger, but of zeal; in which there is nothing of evil; and which is as far from hatred or revenge... as Heaven is from Hell; for it springs from good. The quality of it... cannot be expressed by any words.
Rachel was zealous against her sister = indignation because (interior truth) was not acknowledged as was external.
Jacob was kindled with anger against Rachel = indignation on the part of natural good.

Spiritual indignation itself, and still more celestial indignation, does not derive anything from the anger of the natural man; but from the interior essence of zeal, which zeal in the external form appears like anger, but in the internal form it is not anger, and not even the indignation of anger; but is a certain sadness with a wish that it were not so...
When a man recedes from Societies they are indignant... (and) in their indignation they speak from evil. AC 4077:2.
The Angels are indignant if anything of good and truth is attributed to them... AC 4096:end. AC 4295:2.
Indignation. Signified. AC 4140. AC 4141. AC 4146. AC 4700.
When Spirits are separated from (an angelic Society) they are indignant; and when they are in a state of indignation they come into an obscure state...
Indignation and consequent indifference. Signified.
When a man is in this inundation, he is indignant, angry...
The vastation and destruction of the Church is described by the indignation, anger, and wrath of Jehovah... when yet it is just the contrary; namely, that the man who is in evil is indignant...
On hearing this, he who was a Subject was very indignant.
At this experience the Spirits were indignant in the highest degree; for everyone of them wants to think and speak from himself.
They were very indignant, especially that I should reflect upon (the influx) that it was from them.
They are indignant if they do not have a reward above the rest.
They were not indignant if one should not accede to the opinion of the other.
When regenerate, he is indignant if anyone thinks that he benefits the neighbour for the sake of reward.
For, when the Lord... protects His own... they who are in evil are indignant and angry against the good...
Many of them are very indignant that they had not believed that any life would remain after death.
Indignation that the Divine, thus that the Church itself was not with them. Signified.
That nation was indignant against Jehovah if they did not obtain what they desire...
Good Spirits... being indignant, said that I should declare that they are not minds without form...
I was sometimes indignant that these things were not comprehended (by me).
They are indignant that happiness is not allotted them above others.
And this even to indignation...
They twisted their lips... even to indignation... TCR 111.
Those three wives were indignant...
All love... breaks forth into indignation and anger... when it is wrested from its delights.
From some indignation of zeal for the Truth we spoke... CL 380:8.
That there is a good indignation.
Certain Spirits were indignant... SE 2150.
On indignation and anger (in the World of Spirits against everything true and good).
Some were indignant that thus they were nothing. SE 3645.
They were indignant (that they did not speak from themselves).
They were very indignant that they could neither think nor speak from themselves. SE 2966.
I perceived the indignation from the World of Spirits, that...
He, being indignant, receded.
The spiritual infants... break forth more quickly as it were with indignation, if they perceive anything contrary to what is true and good...
A certain Spirit above the head said something to me from indignation...
The cause of the indignation of the good Spirits was then divulged...
Spirits are indignant because they are not allowed to live in external decorums...
He excited indignation against them, even to a fury of indignation.
The people... shall be indignant () = their indignation on this account.
Perversions of truth are signified by... the staff of mine indignation...
It is (the Divine truth) which is said to be full of indignation...
